Synopsis:
Italy's far-right Futuro Nazionale, led by ex-general Roberto Vannacci (founded Feb 2026, broke from League), has risen to 4th place in polls at 7.5%, overtaking coalition partner Forza Italia (7.1%). PM Meloni's Brothers of Italy leads at 26.8% but is softening. The coalition trails the centre-left PD bloc. Meloni is pushing electoral reform ahead of 2027 elections, which opposition labels self-serving. Whether Futuro Nazionale joins the coalition remains unresolved.
